proposal.reason: Main change is transport-layer P2P/SHM connection setup: transport selection wiring, connection-progress accounting, stream synchronization, and P2P memcpy-path shared-memory descriptor integration/cleanup. Added memory review is needed because shared-memory lifetime/ownership semantics were substantively changed via new handle-based open/import/close APIs, refcounted unlink behavior, and host/device mapping-registration release paths in common shm utilities.
